decisions.reason: As a flagship organic line that fits the firm's stated expansion direction, the option is still very uncertain after one year and costs little to keep on existing slicing and curing capacity, so it stays open.
Organic poultry snacks match the organic growth strategy and have a page of their own, but the niche is uncertain; one year of results is too little to justify abandoning a cheap option.

The premium sharing snack is a low-cost format extension in a crowded snack segment, so it is kept for now while retail listing results reveal its value, though it is the most likely of the three to be dropped.
